process.name: ODC Creation and Amendment instance view
process.description:
When you create a new details UI, the generated human service uses a copy of this template. You can further customize the human service to create your details user interface.

The service template includes:

  • A View instance details coach, which has these coach controls:
    • Default Instance Details Template - displays the instance details in Process Portal
    • Data section view - displays the values of the variables that are passed into the human service
  • A Show error coach - returns an error if the instance is not found.

processVariable.name: unsavedLocalChanges
processVariable.description: This variable is bound to the Data Section coach view. The variable value is set to true when local changes are detected.

processVariable.name: originalInput
processVariable.description: This variable is bound to the Data Section coach view. This variable saves (stores) the original values of the variables on the client. The original values are used to determine how local or remote changes affected the variables on the client.

processVariable.name: incomingChanges
processVariable.description: This variable is bound to the Data Section coach view. This variable contains the updated variable values from the server.

processVariable.name: localChanges
processVariable.description: This variable is bound to the Data Section coach view. It contains the updated variable values from the coach.

processVariable.name: dataSectionBoundaryEventType
processVariable.description: This variable indicates the type of boundary event triggered by the Data Section coach view.

processVariable.name: helperScriptURL
processVariable.description: This variable contains the URL or the managed asset that provides data synchronization functions used in this service.

processVariable.name: incomingChangesMerged
processVariable.description: This variable is bound to the Data Section coach view. Indicates that incoming changes were automatically merged into the local data.

<style>
/* Main container for tabs */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap; /* Allow tabs to wrap onto multiple lines */
    align-items: center;
    padding: 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    list-style-type: none; /* Remove default list styling */
    margin: 0;
}

/* Style each tab */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li {
    /*margin-right: 5px;*/
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    list-style-type: none; /* Ensure no bullets */
    white-space: nowrap; /* Prevent text wrapping inside each tab */
}

/* Tab anchor styling */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a {
    display: block;
    padding: 5px 5px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 3px;
    color: #006547 !important;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    height:26px;
}

/* Active tab and hover state */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li.active > a,
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a:hover {
    background-color: #007bff;
    color:#333;
}

/* Hide the secondary dropdown menu if it exists */
ul.nav.nav-tabs-mnu.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Make sure the first <ul> doesn't get altered by dropdown behavior */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs .dropdown-toggle {
    display: none !important;
}

ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs .dropdown-menu {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Responsive adjustments to ensure tabs wrap correctly */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs {
        flex-direction: row;
        flex-wrap: wrap; /* Ensure tabs wrap on small screens */
    }

    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li {
        margin-right: 0;
        white-space: normal; /* Allow text to wrap within tabs */
    }

    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a {
        text-align: center; /* Center text within tabs */
       /*color: #006547 !important;*/
    }
}
/* Ensure tabs don't leave white space when removed */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li.hidden {
    display: none !important;
}
/* Ensure all tabs are displayed */
.nav-tabs > li {
    display: inline-block !important; /* Override any display:none */
    visibility: visible !important; /* Ensure visibility */
}
